verdict.rationale: Databricks documents OpenSharing as its secure data-sharing platform for sharing data and AI assets with users outside your organization, even if they do not use Databricks. The Marketplace adds a way to publish dataset listings that other customers can discover and connect to from their workspace. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that shares are live with no data copy or export pipeline, detail on cross-account sharing mechanics and setup, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
